lines.trans: Max, what are you doing here?
I am just standing and breathing air.
Are you following me again?
You have an important business meeting right now.
Max, tell the truth, are you jealous?
I am not jealous of you at all, Vika.

words.gram: short for Виктория, used as address

lines.trans: This is a meeting regarding the sale of the restaurant.
I am calm, go to your meeting.
Please drive my car home.
And you will go in his car?

lines.trans: Yes, we will go together to negotiations.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: It is time for me to go, bye, Max.

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

lines.trans: Yes, of course, safe travels, Vika.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

examples.text: Мы с Пашей вместе уже месяц.
examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

meanings.note: the invisible gas substance of atmosphere

examples.text: Успокойся, пойдём на свежий воздух сейчас.
examples.trans: Calm down, let's go out for some fresh air.

examples.text: Я просто стою и дышу воздухом.
examples.trans: I'm just standing here getting some air.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Лёша, что случилось? Дыши, сынок, дыши!
examples.trans: Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?
Which car did you come in?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.

meanings.en: to drive away, move vehicle elsewhere

examples.trans: I will move the van away for now.
The driver moved the car to the garage.

examples.text: Да, мы поедем вместе на переговоры.
examples.trans: Yes, we will go together to negotiations.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.
I'm calling about the shopping centre.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
It's time for us to go.
All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

examples.text: Это встреча по поводу продажи ресторана.
examples.trans: This is a meeting about the sale of the restaurant.

examples.text: Как тебе это удалось? Их нет в продаже!
examples.trans: How did you manage it? They're not on sale anywhere!

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: счастливого пути = have a good trip

examples.trans: Here's a movie: The Thorny Path.
Yes, of course, have a good trip, Vika.

examples.text: Ты сам выбрал этот страшный путь.
examples.trans: You chose this terrible path yourself.
Are you jealous of my past?
Max, tell the truth, are you jealous?

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Это ваша самоуверенность промелькнула. Спокойной ночи!
examples.trans: That was your overconfidence flashing by. Good night!

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?
The film has a happy ending.

examples.text: Ты сейчас один против всех. Счастливого конца не будет.
examples.trans: Right now you're alone against everyone. There won't be a happy ending.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
Do you want me to tell you honestly?

examples.text: Всё честно, Лёха. Взрослые не умеют ждать.
examples.trans: It's all fair, Lyokha. Grown-ups can't wait.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!
